summary: The paid and file-writing novel commands (run, aspects, restyle, pack, batch, variants, compose, plan brief-to-shotlist, upload, download, init) carry pp:live-happy-path plus cheap pp:happy-args so an approved live dogfood run exercises each one for real, once, on the cheapest models (pruna-ai/p-image/text-to-image, wavespeed-ai/z-image/turbo, wavespeed-ai/z-image-turbo/image-to-image, wavespeed-ai/any-llm). testdata/dogfood/red-circle.png is the 922-byte upload fixture. Three commands that ignored --dry-run now honor it: download lists planned paths without fetching, library export writes nothing, and library tag previews instead of tagging. run, aspects and restyle dry runs name the previewed action.
reason: publish validate refused the reprint for hollow coverage: these commands could only be dry-run, so the phase5 gate never saw them run. Cathryn approved a capped paid run ($2 cap). The annotation is inert without the press flag from mvanhorn/cli-printing-press#4872 and dogfood --allow-destructive. The dry-run fixes are real bugs the approved run exposed: the dry_run_json probe downloaded a file and exported the library into the CLI tree.
validated_outcome: Full live dogfood with --allow-destructive behind a capped spend guard (allowlisted cheap models, per-model quota, $0.25 ceiling): all 11 features covered, coverage_hollow false. Real spend per billing records is reported in the PR. dry_run_side_effects_test.go fails on the pre-fix code and passes on the fix. Compatibility test against 2026.10.1 green.
